label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Wentworth Move
items.text: Rory McIlroy and wife Erica moved into a renovated six-bedroom mansion steps from Wentworth Club, making the BMW PGA Championship more personal and logistically easy this week.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Eagle Boost
items.text: Rory McIlroy holed an eagle on the 18th to finish three-under 72, moving within two shots of the lead and keeping his hopes alive to pass Patrick Reed in DP World Tour standings with a solo second or better.

items.headline: DeChambeau Skips BMW PGA
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau chose to skip the BMW PGA Championship this week, missing a key European Tour event during its final round action.
